$comment: One public Runpod template (the studio has one install; turn models off with DOWNLOAD_*_MODELS under Set overrides). deploy-template.mjs creates/updates it and records its id in presets.lock.json. The retired presets (storyboard, video, perform) stay in the lock file; their templates were made private, not deleted, so old links don't break.
